'''Volodymyr Nykyforov''' is a [[Ukrainians|Ukrainian]] biologist, ecologist and biotechnologist, Doctor of Science, Professor.<ref name="30 Years of scientific and pedagogical activity of professor Volodymyr V. Nykyforov">{{Cite web|url=http://science.lpnu.ua/sites/default/files/journal-paper/2019/may/16775/4.pdf|title=30 Years of scientific and pedagogical activity of professor Volodymyr V. Nykyforov}}</ref> He serves as first vice-rector of [[Kremenchuk Mykhailo Ostrohradskyi National University]].<ref name="Kremenchuk Mykhailo Ostrohradskyi National University">{{Cite web|url=http://www.kdu.edu.ua/en/admin.php|title=Kremenchuk Mykhailo Ostrohradskyi National University (KrNU)|website=www.kdu.edu.ua}}</ref>
